experiments.scope: A fresh seven-word outer input,19-bit class member and21-bit cube member per organizer seed. The counter constructor and direct compressions are source-inspected participant code; output pairs are the separately rebuilt root instance.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned55/63-byte complete root digests agree on words0,2,5,7. Counter-half/beta observations are untrusted finite checks. This experiment does not establish the rare full-collision rate or a global attack cost.
